title: TensorPlate CLI Config
description: Versioned configuration for `tensorplate-cli` (V01-E11). The CLI loads this file at startup, validates it before any command runs, and refuses to call the agent until validation succeeds. v0.1.0 implements `local` and explicit `url` modes; `ssh-tunnel`, `overlay`, and `relay` are reserved in the schema and fail at command execution with a typed `Unsupported` error.

schema_version.description: Independent versioning track for the CLI config. Unknown versions return a typed `config_invalid` error.

default_profile.description: Profile selected when neither `--profile` nor `--agent-url` is supplied.

output.description: Output defaults. Per-command flags override these.

timeout_ms.description: Default request timeout for agent calls. Per-command flags override.

log_source.description: Where `tensorplate logs` reads structured log entries when the active profile is `local`.

path.description: Absolute path to a structured log file (NDJSON) or a directory containing per-component NDJSON logs.

tail_default.description: Default number of trailing entries returned when `--tail` is not supplied.

profiles.description: Named device access profiles. Keys are profile names; values describe how to reach one agent. Profiles never refer to more than one agent; multi-device orchestration belongs to the hosted platform.

mode.description: v0.1.0 implements `local` and `url`. The remaining modes are reserved and return typed `Unsupported` errors at command execution.

socket_path.description: Absolute path to the agent's Unix domain socket. Required for `local` mode.

agent_url.description: `host:port` of the agent's loopback TCP endpoint reachable over SSH/VPN/overlay. Required for `url` mode.

serving_url.description: Optional override for `tensorplate infer`. Format: `http://host:port`. When absent, the CLI discovers the serving endpoint from the active deployment in agent status.
